channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Club Update: League Final Bound & Cup Wins
item.description: A week of mixed results: playoff exits for Grade 4 Mixed and Grade 3 Mixed, three Cup wins on the bounce, and Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ reach the League Final vs Kildalkey on Tuesday 10th March in Wilkinstown. No Club Night this Wednesday due to MBA Mixed League Finals.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Badminton Round-Up: Cup Semi-Final Secured & Big League Matches Ahead
item.description: A busy week of badminton with hard-fought draws, a Cup win on points for our Grade 6 Mens to reach the Semi-Final, and key league fixtures coming up. Note: No club night on Wednesday 4th March—adult club nights are Monday 2nd and Thursday 5th.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: This Wednesday: Claremont Stadium Club Night
item.description: Two big Grade 6 Mixed fixtures at Claremont this Wednesday: Navan A in a must-win league match vs Ardee, and Navan B in a knockout cup tie vs Athboy/Kells. Members’ courts open from 8:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 13 Matches Played, Big Wins & Cup Drama
item.description: A busy week of 13 matches featuring strong away wins, hard-earned draws, and dramatic cup ties—now it’s on to 14 fixtures next week across Meath League, Dublin League, and the Meath Cup.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Weekly Round-Up: 5 Matches Played, 13 More to Come
item.description: A busy week of league and cup action: two league draws, a big cup win for Grade 7 Mixed, and a tough away loss for Grade 2 Men’s. Next week ramps up with 13 matches across league and cup.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 12 Matches Completed: Big League Wins & Cup Drama

item.title: Busy Week: 10 Matches, Big League Wins & 3 Cup Victories
item.description: A huge week with 10 matches played: standout league wins across Mixed and Ladies teams, two hard-fought Grade 2 Mixed draws, and three dramatic cup victories including two 7–5 thrillers. Another 11 matches await next week.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Unbeaten Start to 2026: 2 Wins & 3 Draws in a Big Week
item.description: An unbeaten start to 2026 with 2 wins and 3 draws across five matches, and a huge week ahead with at least 12 fixtures including Cup action starting Sunday.

item.description: Join us for Week 27's Cup Madness with five big fixtures, including semi-finals and finals. Good luck to all Navan teams!
